shipped_pick_invalid.why: The shipped cases' pick card got a pick that is not a list of case ids. Nothing was picked; the card's step stops for the user.

shipped_pick_empty.why: The shipped cases' pick card was approved with no case ticked. Nothing was picked; the step stops for the user.

shipped_pick_duplicate.why: The shipped cases' pick named one case twice. Nothing was picked; the step stops for the user.

shipped_pick_unknown.why: The shipped cases' pick named an id that is not a case of the cases file. Nothing was picked; the step stops for the user.

shipped_pick_finance.why: The shipped cases' pick named a case that needs no solve; those always run (read not evaluated) and are never picked. Nothing was picked; the step stops for the user.

shipped_pick_closed.why: The shipped cases' step no longer waits on that pick card (another card, another runner, or already picked). Nothing was written.
